name: L'église
style: ink and gouache storybook, natural daylight, pale cream limestone, cool slate floor, reverent

items.surface: left floor near niche; crow grounded in front of cross
items.pose: A black CROW stands on the floor looking up at a wooden CROSS. Crow recalls croix [KRWAH]. The crow never touches the cross.

card.hook: A black CROW stands on the floor looking up at a wooden CROSS. Crow recalls croix [KRWAH]. The crow never touches the cross.
card.note: Not a cognate of 'crow'. Related to crucifix, crux.
ex: The cross is made of wood.

items.pose: An everyday candle decorated with pearls and a tiny tiara, looking a bit 'bougie'. Bougie recalls bougie [boo-ZHEE].

card.hook: An everyday candle decorated with pearls and a tiny tiara, looking a bit 'bougie'. Bougie recalls bougie [boo-ZHEE].
card.note: Everyday candle. Tall liturgical candle is le cierge (right side).

items.surface: left floor beside the left bench
items.pose: An old bronze church bell wearing a 1920s cloche hat. Cloche recalls cloche [KLOSH].

card.hook: An old bronze church bell wearing a 1920s cloche hat. Cloche recalls cloche [KLOSH].
card.note: English 'cloche' = the hat; French simply means bell.

items.surface: left foreground floor; chair legs grounded
items.pose: A rush-seated church chair with a chessboard set up on its seat. Chess recalls chaise [SHEZ].

card.hook: A rush-seated church chair with a chessboard set up on its seat. Chess recalls chaise [SHEZ].
card.note: Village churches often use chairs rather than pews. Armchair = le fauteuil.

items.pose: A simple golden chalice standing on the altar. Plain meaning depiction of le calice.

card.hook: A simple golden chalice standing on the altar. Plain meaning depiction of le calice.

items.surface: right floor beside the altar steps
items.pose: A very tall white church candle on a brass stand. Plain meaning depiction of le cierge.

card.hook: A very tall white church candle on a brass stand. Plain meaning depiction of le cierge.
card.note: Tall liturgical candle. Everyday candle is la bougie (left side).

items.surface: hanging from right side, near the window
items.pose: A brass censer hanging from a chain with gentle smoke. Plain meaning depiction of l'encens.

card.hook: A brass censer hanging from a chain with gentle smoke. Plain meaning depiction of l'encens.

items.surface: hanging from the right bench / pew
items.pose: A wooden rosary hanging neatly from the end of the pew. Plain meaning depiction of le chapelet.

card.hook: A wooden rosary hanging neatly from the end of the pew. Plain meaning depiction of le chapelet.

items.surface: right bench seat; piggy bank sitting on the pew
items.pose: A pink piggy BANK sits on the church BENCH. Bank recalls banc [BAHN].

card.hook: A pink piggy BANK sits on the church BENCH. Bank recalls banc [BAHN].
card.note: False friend: means bench, NOT bank (la banque).
ex: Nous nous asseyons sur le banc.

dialogue.title: À l'église
lines: Regarde la croix. Il y a un corbeau devant.
Look at the cross. There's a crow in front of it.
Oui. Et la bougie est allumée sur l'étagère.
Yes. And the candle is lit on the shelf.
Le calice est sur l'autel. C'est beau.
The chalice is on the altar. It's beautiful.
Allons nous asseoir sur le banc.
Let's go sit on the bench.
